@Ress Kent вот моя фунька для генерации навигации для форумов
function links()
{
    global $user, $datastore, $bb_cfg, $page_cfg;

    if (!$forums = $datastore->get('cat_forums'))
    {
        $datastore->update('cat_forums');
        $forums = $datastore->get('cat_forums');
    }
   
    $links = '';

    $excluded_forums_csv = $user->get_excluded_forums(AUTH_VIEW);
    $allowed_forums = array_diff(explode(',', $forums['list_forums']), explode(',', $excluded_forums_csv.$bb_cfg['portal']['ignor_link']));
    $url = !empty($page_cfg['show_links'][BB_SCRIPT]) && (BB_SCRIPT == 'portal') ? PORTAL_URL : FORUM_URL;
   
    foreach ($allowed_forums as $row)
    {
        $links .= '<li><a title="'.$forums['forum_name_html'][$row].'" href="'. $url.$row .'">'. $forums['forum_name_html'][$row] .'</a></li>';
    }

    unset($forums);
    $datastore->rm('cat_forums');

    return $links;
}
